'''Falco''' was an [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|Advanced Recon Force]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] in the [[Excelsior Company]], under the command of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Vargus]]. His<ref name="The Lost Legion" /> armor featured stripes of orange down his arms, legs, and across his chest plate.<ref name="The Lost Legion" />

In addition to his skills in the field of reconnaissance, Falco was a clever tactician. He was able to analyze a situation and decide how best to utilize a small force against a larger enemy. Falco also possessed a dry, understated sense of humor.<ref name="The Lost Legion" />

==Appearances==
*''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: The Lost Legion]]''
